svg.title: Grow the pure InAs segment
svg.desc: The source does not separately report this control’s segment-growth duration; 10 min from Figure 3a is not inherited. Growth follows directly after the InP stem without GI 2; an exact temperature transition is not separately stated. All precursor pressures are measured gas-line pressures used as flux references, not chamber total pressure, gas dose or molar concentration. Qualified CBE chamber/substrate schematic; no unreported chamber shape, gas manifold, heater geometry or liquid reaction vessel is asserted.

g.text: Precursor pressures are gas-LINE pressures used as flux references.
